name: Sugar Service
source:
Meet, Date, Grow, Expand, and Dominate the Rent-a-Partner market.
Sugar Service is an ADULT (18+), RPG, Management, Card-game, Dating-sim Visual Novel.
You and your cute long-time friend co-start a Rent-a-Partner start-up business,
that also doubles as a Camgirl Agency to meet end's meet.

As you grow in this sex work industry, you'll meet new VIP clients,
hire new camgirls, expand your talent, and improve your dating skills.
Dates are done through our card-minigame we call 'Love & Seduction'.
Impress your date or come out scathed and embarrassed.
Whatever you have to do to make next month's rent.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/sugarservice/about]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
结识、约会、成长、扩展并主导租赁合作伙伴市场。
Sugar Service是一款成人（18岁以上）、角色扮演、管理、卡牌游戏、约会模拟视觉小说。
你和你可爱的老朋友共同创办了一家租赁合作伙伴初创企业，
这也兼作Camgirl Agency来满足。

随着你在性工作行业的成长，你会遇到新的VIP客户，
雇佣新的女主播，拓展你的才华，提高你的约会技巧。
约会是通过我们称为“爱与诱惑”的卡片小游戏完成的。
给你的约会对象留下深刻的印象，否则就会受到伤害和尴尬。
无论你需要做什么才能支付下个月的房租。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/sugarservice/about]Patreon[/url]]
